title: PermissionRuleList
description: `GET /permission-rules`: the caller's rules, newest first — expired ones included and marked, revoked ones gone (plan 03). Paginated by cursor over `(granted_at, id)` (plan 15, D-13, decided 2026-11-05 against the plan's own original recommendation of a flat list with a ceiling): the first page with no `cursor` is unchanged in content from before plan 15, which is what keeps the published app — which reads neither `cursor` nor `nextCursor` — on the same contract (S-01, S-02). `nextCursor` is optional here only because the cursor read is wired phase by phase (F1, B-10); the normative contract, where it is always present, is `backend/03-modules.md`'s `permission` section.

nextCursor.description: Opaque to the client: send it back as `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last one.
